'''Obor''', the Hill Titan, is the hill [[Giant (race)|giant]] [[boss]] residing in his lair, located behind the locked gates found at the western wall of the hill giant area in the [[Edgeville Dungeon]].

A [[giant key]] is needed to unlock the [[Gate (Obor)|gate]] leading to Obor's lair for the first time, which may be acquired by killing [[Hill Giants]]. Subsequent access to the lair does not require a key. The key will not be consumed when unlocking Obor's lair. When the player first enters Obor's lair, they will be in a safe zone, where they must climb down the rocks in order to fight him. Obor attacks with [[Melee]] and [[Ranged]].

After defeating Obor, the [[Chest_(Obor's_lair)|chest]] present in his lair can be opened for loot by consuming the [[giant key]], similarly to [[Bryophyta]].

Obor can be fought repeatedly by attempting to open [[Chest (Obor's Lair)|his chest]]. This will trigger him to respawn shortly after, regardless of whether the player has a [[giant key]] in their inventory. This means you can continue to kill him as a method of obtaining more keys, which he drops at a rate of 1/16. However, using the key on the chest is required for the [[kill count]] to increase and to obtain the loot from the chest after the fight.

Obor will also respawn immediately upon leaving and re-entering the instance. When changing worlds while in the instanced zone, the player will be teleported outside the instance.

Obor's ranged attack deals 50% less damage when [[Protect from Missiles]] is used.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1354043801187319809|date=26 January 2021|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/104955|archivedate=2 March 2021|quote=It has a ranged attack that deals 50% less damage if you've got that prayer active. That sounds intentional to me - we do this sort of damage reduction quite often with bosses.}}

==Strategy==
===Magic (Snare)===
[[File:Fighting Obor.png|thumb|right|250px|A player fighting Obor, the Hill Titan.]]
Lower-level players (with 50 [[Magic]] and 40 [[Prayer]]) need to remember to always turn on [[Protect from Missiles]] '''before''' climbing down and starting the fight. Start with [[Snare]] to prevent Obor from reaching you and recast it every time Obor is able to walk again. Use the highest available Magic spell to kill him. To efficiently maintain distance and minimise damage taken, wait for Obor to be as close to one end of the room before Snaring, then run to the other side, casting offensive spells in between. Wait until he walks to the opposite wall again before repeating. Even with this strategy, remember to bring enough food. Obor can do serious damage as soon as the Snare wears off. If you are free-to-play you might want to bring an [[energy potion]] as well.

It can be useful to know that Obor does not always keep walking up to [[melee]] distance before attacking. This means he might stop walking towards you before standing next to you, giving you the time to snare or bind him without having to run to the other side of the arena. This makes it easier to cast more spells in a shorter amount of time, making the fight more efficient.

Note: It's been observed that [[Snare]] does not seem to immobilize Obor for the full 9.6 seconds on occasion (consistently?). If you're a member, try using higher level binding abilities such as [[Entangle]] or the [[Ice spells]].

===Magic (Tank)===
As Obor is weak to magic, this is the preferred combat style for members with at least 50 [[Magic]], 60 [[Defence]] and 42 in the other combat stats. You should wear [[Void Knight equipment|void knight]] or [[Elite Void Knight equipment|elite void knight]] equipment with the [[void mage helm]]. Stand with your back against a wall to avoid knock-backs. Pray a Defence-boosting prayer such as [[Steel Skin]]. Expect to take more damage using this method.

===Ranged===
For free-to-play, at least 50 [[Defence]] and 60 [[Ranged]] along with 40 [[Prayer]] for [[Protect from Missiles]] are recommended for Obor. Players should wear a [[rune chainbody]] as it provides the best Defence against Obor's crush without lowering Ranged attack bonus. Members with 75 [[Ranged]] should use a [[toxic blowpipe]] as Obor's low Defence level combined with its fast attack speed makes it the strongest weapon to use against him.

===Melee===
Melee is also a good option, as it is faster than the magic method (snare) to kill Obor, but it will be more dangerous. At least level 50 Attack/Strength/Defence and 40 [[Prayer]] for [[Protect from Missiles]] are recommended. Obor's slam attack can knock you back, and your next attack will be slightly delayed whether you are standing next to a wall or not. Members can use an [[abyssal whip]] or a [[dragon scimitar]], while free players can use a [[rune scimitar]]. You'll also want good melee armour with decent ranged and melee defensive stats. If you are free-to-play, you may also want to bring a [[Strength potion]].

{{Subject changes
|date = 25 June 2025
|update = Summer Sweep Up: Combat
|change = 
* Obor no longer requires a [[giant key]] to be fought. However, the first encounter with him will still require the key as a means to permanently unlock access to the boss.
* Obor's drop table has been replaced with a simpler loot table similar to [[hill giant]]s, with an increased chance at a [[giant key]], as well as a chance of [[giant bones]] for members.
* Obor's original loot table has been moved to [[Chest (Obor's Lair)|a chest]] within his lair, which is opened using a [[giant key]] and can only be opened when he is defeated.
* Obor now has a 20% [[elemental weakness]] to [[earth spells]].
}}

* Obor was originally suggested by Reddit user ''Mjterp''.{{CiteForum|author = Mjterp|url = https://www.reddit.com/r/2007scape/comments/4zdg98/f2p_hill_giant_boss_suggestion/|title = F2P Hill Giant Boss Suggestion|forum = Reddit|postdate = 24 August 2016}}
